ham-nghi.name: Vua Hàm Nghi
ham-nghi.look: a young Vietnamese emperor, short and slim, youthful round face, calm serious eyes, bright yellow imperial robe with a simple round dragon outline on the chest (no characters), small yellow wrapped turban, black cloth shoes

ton-that-thuyet.name: Tôn Thất Thuyết
ton-that-thuyet.look: a stern Vietnamese Nguyen dynasty regent and general aged about 46, big sturdy body, dark tanned square face, thick black eyebrows, short black mustache and short black beard, fierce eyes, black wrapped turban, vermilion red silk court robe with wide sleeves, wide black belt, a sheathed sword at his side

nguyen-van-tuong.name: Nguyễn Văn Tường
nguyen-van-tuong.look: a Vietnamese Nguyen dynasty regent mandarin aged about 59, thin, long narrow face, thin grey mustache and small grey goatee, narrow cautious eyes, black wrapped turban, teal blue silk court robe with wide sleeves, holding a closed folding fan

harmand.name: Hác-măng (Harmand)
harmand.look: a French colonial civil commissioner aged about 38, slim, pale face, neat brown mustache and small pointed brown beard, arrogant smug expression, black frock coat, white shirt, black bow tie, black top hat

de-courcy.name: Đờ Cuốc-xi (De Courcy)
de-courcy.look: a French army general aged about 58, stout with a round belly, red cheeks, big bushy white walrus mustache, dark navy blue general's tunic with gold buttons and gold embroidered cuffs, dark blue kepi with gold braid, red trousers, a sword at his side

tu-duc.name: Vua Tự Đức
tu-duc.look: a frail elderly Vietnamese emperor aged about 54, pale thin face, thin black mustache, tired kind eyes, pale yellow imperial robe, pale yellow wrapped turban

truong-quang-ngoc.name: Trương Quang Ngọc
truong-quang-ngoc.look: a Vietnamese mountain chieftain aged about 30, lean, shifty eyes glancing sideways, thin black mustache, dark indigo tunic, black head wrap, red waist sash, a short knife at his belt

linh-phap.name: Lính Pháp 1880 (hình tượng)
linh-phap.look: a French marine soldier of the 1880s, European man with a brown mustache, white cork sun helmet, dark navy blue tunic with brass buttons, white trousers, rifle with a long bayonet

quan-ta.name: Lính triều Nguyễn (hình tượng)
quan-ta.look: a Vietnamese Nguyen dynasty soldier of the 1880s, slim young man, small pointed lacquered conical hat with a brass tip, short red tunic with dark blue borders and a plain round white patch on the chest without characters, black trousers, barefoot, holding a long spear

scenes.narration: Rạng sáng ngày năm tháng Bảy năm một tám tám lăm, kinh thành Huế chìm trong khói lửa.
scenes.image: Wide high view before dawn: the Hue imperial citadel engulfed in fire, the Ngo Mon gate pavilion silhouetted against a huge orange glow, black smoke columns rising, tiny flashes of gunfire along the walls, the Perfume River reflecting the flames in the foreground. scenes.narration: Qua cửa Hữu, một đoàn người lặng lẽ thoát ra giữa tiếng súng.
scenes.image: Pre-dawn, medium-wide view in front of the Cua Huu (south-west gate) of the Hue citadel: a thick old brick and stone citadel wall with ONE big round-arched gate tunnel, on top of the wall above the arch a small single-storey wooden watchtower pavilion with a curved yellow tiled roof, and set into the wall directly above the arch a large horizontal dark red wooden name plaque with a gold border that is COMPLETELY BLANK: a small column of people in dark robes slips quietly out of the arch toward the viewer, bent low, some carrying bundles; burning torches on both sides of the arch, orange fire glow and smoke behind the wall, gunfire flashes in the sky, wet dark stone road in the foreground

scenes.narration: Trong đoàn người ấy, có một cậu bé mười ba tuổi bị kéo tay đi, mắt vẫn ngoái lại phía sau.

scenes.narration: Cậu không mang theo ngai vàng, cũng chẳng mang theo kho báu nào.
scenes.image: Insert, low angle inside a dark abandoned throne hall: a big empty golden throne on red lacquered steps, an open wooden chest of gold ingots left on the steps in the foreground, a fallen yellow silk parasol, cold moonlight beams through the open doors, orange fire glow behind the lattice windows. Nobody in the scene: no people, no figures, no soldiers, no faces

scenes.narration: Thứ cậu để lại cho đất nước, chỉ là một tờ giấy.
scenes.image: Extreme close-up insert: a small hand in a bright yellow silk sleeve holds one rolled paper scroll tied with a red cord in the centre of the frame, the scroll lit by a soft warm glow; dark blurred palace corridor with red lanterns behind

scenes.narration: Vì sao một vị vua lại bỏ ngai vàng để vào rừng? Và một tờ giấy, thì làm được gì trước đại bác?
scenes.image: Visual metaphor, low camera angle in a jungle clearing at dusk: the young emperor (in a plain brown tunic) stands small in the centre holding up one rolled paper scroll toward a gigantic black French cannon that towers over him and fills the right half of the frame; bamboo and banana leaves frame the edges, orange dusk light. Keep the top quarter of the frame calm and simple (dark sky, smoke or plain wall) with no important details, room for a big title

scenes.narration: Hôm nay, hãy cùng Vy lần lại hai năm sóng gió nhất của kinh thành Huế nhé.
scenes.image: Grand view of the Hue citadel at sunrise: the Ngo Mon gate with its two-storey pavilion and yellow tiled roofs, the wide Perfume River with small sampans in front, flowering trees in the foreground; heavy dark storm clouds rolling in from the sea over the golden sunrise, birds flying away. Nobody in the scene: no people, no figures, no soldiers, no faces

scenes.narration: Tháng Bảy năm một tám tám ba, ở Huế, vua Tự Đức băng hà, không có con trai nối ngôi.
scenes.image: Inside a dim imperial bedchamber: the frail old emperor lies in bed under a yellow silk canopy, large in the frame, eyes peacefully closed; in the foreground the backs of kneeling mandarins in black turbans with bowed heads; tall red candles, incense smoke, cold grey light from a window with rain

scenes.narration: Ở tập trước, quân Pháp đã chiếm thành Hà Nội. Chưa đầy một tháng sau khi vua mất, chiến thuyền của họ nã pháo vào cửa biển Thuận An, sát nách kinh thành.
scenes.image: (ảnh giữ lại: map: French warships to Thuan An (old s007))

scenes.narration: Ba ngày. Các đồn canh giữ cửa biển thất thủ.
scenes.image: A Vietnamese soldier large in the foreground runs back across a smoking earthen fort on grey sand dunes, looking back in fear; behind him French marines climb over the broken wall; smoke, small fires, a toppled old bronze cannon; on a wooden post in the foreground three fresh knife tally marks

scenes.narration: Viên đại diện Pháp là Hác-măng gửi tối hậu thư: triều đình có đúng hai mươi bốn giờ để trả lời.
scenes.image: Medium shot inside a Hue palace hall with red lacquered pillars, carved golden wooden screens, hanging red paper lanterns and a polished tiled floor in perspective, grey storm light: the French commissioner, large on the right, holds out a sealed letter with a red wax seal; a nervous Vietnamese mandarin in a black turban on the left with sweat drops; on the table in the foreground between them a big hourglass with the sand running out fast. Keep the top quarter of the frame calm and simple (dark sky, smoke or plain wall) with no important details, room for a big title

scenes.narration: Triều đình ký hòa ước Quý Mùi. Trong đó có hai chữ: "bảo hộ".

scenes.narration: Nghe như được che chở. Nhưng từ nay, muốn nói chuyện với bất cứ nước nào, triều đình cũng phải đi qua người Pháp.
scenes.image: Gag at a red lacquered table in a palace pavilion: a Vietnamese mandarin in a black turban on the left holds out a sealed letter toward a Qing Chinese envoy in a round hat on the right, but a smug French official in a black frock coat leans in between them, large in the centre, and snatches the letter in mid-air; both envoys look shocked

scenes.narration: Giống như một ngôi nhà vẫn treo biển tên chủ cũ, nhưng chìa khóa cửa đã nằm trong túi người khác.
scenes.image: Gag: a traditional Vietnamese wooden house with a curved tiled roof, a large horizontal plain wooden board that is COMPLETELY BLANK (no writing) above the door; the Vietnamese owner in a black turban stands large in the left foreground looking at it sadly; a French officer leans in the doorway twirling a big iron key ring, smug; potted bonsai, lanterns, grey afternoon light

scenes.narration: Còn trong cung, ngồi lên ngai vàng lúc ấy, còn nguy hiểm hơn đứng ngoài cửa biển.
scenes.image: Inside a dim palace throne hall: a golden throne on red steps in the centre, long dark shadows of grasping hands reach toward it from both sides across the floor, cracks in the floor tiles, red pillars framing the shot, one beam of cold moonlight; outside the window far away a stormy sea. Nobody in the scene: no people, no figures, no soldiers, no faces

scenes.narration: Chỉ trong khoảng một năm, bốn vị vua lần lượt bước lên ngai.
scenes.image: Gag still life in a palace dressing room: four bright yellow imperial robes on four wooden clothes stands in a row; the first three stands are knocked over with their yellow robes crumpled on the floor, only the fourth stand is still upright with its robe; red pillars and one lantern behind. scenes.title: MỘT NĂM, BỐN VUA

scenes.narration: Vua Dục Đức: ba ngày, rồi bị phế.
scenes.image: A young Vietnamese emperor of about 30 in a yellow robe, large in the frame, is escorted out of the throne hall by two palace guards gripping his arms, surprised face; on a side table in the foreground three short burnt-out candles

scenes.narration: Vua Hiệp Hòa: bốn tháng, rồi bị ép uống thuốc độc.
scenes.image: Night in a dim palace room: a middle-aged Vietnamese emperor in a yellow robe sits slumped and frightened, large in the frame, while a stern official's arm in a dark sleeve holds out a small cup on a lacquered tray toward him in the foreground; one oil lamp casting long shadows on the wall

scenes.narration: Vua Kiến Phúc: tám tháng, rồi qua đời khi mới mười lăm tuổi.
scenes.image: A pale thin young Vietnamese emperor in a yellow robe lies sick in bed under a canopy, large in the frame, an old physician kneels feeling his pulse; a steaming medicine bowl in the foreground, dim candlelight, worried servants behind

scenes.narration: Đứng sau những lần thay vua ấy, là hai vị phụ chính: Nguyễn Văn Tường và Tôn Thất Thuyết.
scenes.image: Low angle: the two regents stand side by side, knee-up and large, behind an empty golden throne, one in teal and one in red, looking down sternly at the viewer, inside a Hue palace hall with red lacquered pillars, carved golden wooden screens, hanging red paper lanterns and a polished tiled floor in perspective

scenes.narration: Chỗ này sử chép khác nhau. Có người bảo họ đặt vua lên rồi nhấc xuống như những quân cờ.
scenes.image: Gag, high angle: two giant hands from above, one in a red silk sleeve and one in a teal silk sleeve, move small emperor figurines in yellow robes on a big chessboard that fills the frame; two figurines already knocked over; candle light on a palace floor

scenes.narration: Có người lại cho rằng, họ đang tìm cho bằng được một ông vua dám chống Pháp.
scenes.image: The red-robed regent stands large in the foreground at an open palace window, seen over his shoulder, fist clenched, determined angry eyebrows, watching French warships with smoking funnels on the river outside; wooden lattice frames the shot

scenes.narration: Tháng Sáu năm một tám tám bốn, triều đình ký thêm hòa ước Giáp Thân.

scenes.narration: Đến đây, ai cũng tưởng nhà Nguyễn đã cúi đầu hẳn.
scenes.image: High angle wide view of a palace courtyard: a long row of Vietnamese mandarins in black turbans and colourful robes bow deeply toward a French diplomat in a black frock coat, white shirt and black bow tie, grey mustache, bare head (no hat) and French officers standing at the top of the stairs; yellow tiled roofs, grey sky

scenes.narration: Tháng Tám năm ấy, ngai vàng có người thứ tư: một cậu bé mười ba tuổi tên Ưng Lịch.
scenes.image: Coronation, low angle: the young emperor sits on a huge golden throne, his feet not touching the floor, looking small and serious; rows of mandarins kneeling below in the foreground; warm golden light, red pillars, incense smoke, yellow parasols

scenes.narration: Trước đó, cậu sống ngoài cung, ăn uống đạm bạc như con nhà thường dân.
scenes.image: Warm sunny flashback: the young emperor (wearing plain brown commoner clothes instead of the robe) eats a simple bowl of rice with a pair of chopsticks, sitting on a bamboo bench in front of a humble thatched village house, chickens and banana trees around, large in the frame

scenes.narration: Cậu chưa từng nghĩ mình sẽ làm vua. Giờ, cậu là vua Hàm Nghi.
scenes.image: The young emperor in his yellow robe stands large in front of a tall bronze mirror in a palace room, looking at it in wonder; in the mirror his reflection wears plain brown commoner clothes; warm lantern light

scenes.narration: Người đứng cạnh cậu là Tôn Thất Thuyết, người cầm đầu phe chủ chiến.
scenes.image: The red-robed regent stands large beside the young emperor's golden throne with his hand on his sword hilt, protective and stern, the young emperor seated; inside a Hue palace hall with red lacquered pillars, carved golden wooden screens, hanging red paper lanterns and a polished tiled floor in perspective

scenes.narration: Ngoài mặt, ông vẫn tiếp đón sứ Pháp. Sau lưng, ông lặng lẽ chuẩn bị.
scenes.image: Split composition: the red-robed regent bows politely to a French diplomat in a black frock coat, white shirt and black bow tie, grey mustache, bare head (no hat), but behind his back his hand grips his sword hilt, shown clearly in the foreground; palace courtyard with red pillars

scenes.narration: Ông lập những đội quân riêng, lấy tên là Phấn Nghĩa.
scenes.image: Training ground in front of palace walls: the red-robed regent stands large in the foreground with arms crossed; behind him rows of young Vietnamese soldiers practise thrusting spears in unison, dust, morning sun

scenes.narration: Ông cho tích trữ lương thực, súng đạn, chuyển bớt vàng bạc ra khỏi kinh thành.
scenes.image: Night: workers carry wooden chests and sacks of rice onto ox carts out of a palace side gate, lit by red lanterns; one worker large in the foreground puts a finger to his lips, secretive

scenes.narration: Và giữa núi rừng Quảng Trị, ông bí mật dựng một căn cứ: sơn phòng Tân Sở.
scenes.image: a jungle mountain fortress: a tall wooden palisade gate with two small watchtowers, thatched barracks and earthen walls among dense green jungle, misty mountains behind, seen from the path in front of the gate; above the gate hangs a large horizontal plain wooden board that is COMPLETELY BLANK (no writing); soldiers carry supplies in through the gate, morning mist

scenes.narration: Hãy nhớ cái tên ấy. Một năm sau, nhà vua sẽ phải chạy về đó.
scenes.image: Extreme close-up insert: the tip of a fine ink brush draws a red circle around a tiny hidden fort among green mountains on an aged parchment map; the map fills the frame, an oil lamp glow at the edge; no labels, no letters. Nobody in the scene: no people, no figures, no soldiers, no faces

scenes.narration: Đầu tháng Bảy năm một tám tám lăm, tướng Pháp Đờ Cuốc-xi kéo quân tới Huế.
scenes.image: The French general on horseback, large in the foreground, leads a long column of French marines along the Perfume River toward the walls of the Hue citadel; banana trees and the riverbank, hot afternoon light

scenes.image: A road splits into two at dawn on a hill: two young Vietnamese scholars seen from behind, large in the foreground, faces not visible, each walks down a different path: the one on the left in a dark indigo robe carries a sword toward a distant battlefield with smoke and dark mountains, the one on the right in a white robe carries a book toward a sunny village with a small school house; big dawn sky

scenes.narration: Cảm ơn bạn đã xem hết video. Nếu đoán được họ là ai, hãy để lại bình luận, và nhớ theo dõi Vy để không bỏ lỡ tập sau nhé.
scenes.image: Dusk on the Perfume River: an empty small wooden sampan and a glowing paper lantern drift in the foreground, the silhouette of the Ngo Mon gate with its two-storey pavilion far behind, orange and purple sky, calm and melancholic. Nobody in the scene: no people, no figures, no soldiers, no faces
